content:
Alice Park: Pager triggered: KV cache continuous-batch growth -> latency spike and 5xxs on dedicated customers in eu-west1. Notable models: Mistral-Base variants and Qwen-MQA requests. Seeing sustained batch sizes ramp to >400 tokens per request window, causing per-shard KV blowup.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: KV-CACHE-CONTBATCH-1765432100 severity:high priority:page

Devon Li: I'm looking at infra graphs — evictions are failing, mem usage on rid-27 up to 94%. QPS is steady but average tokens/server jumped. Probably prefix-KV retention + cont-batching window misestimate.

Maria Gonzales: customer-impact: 3 Dedicated tenants showing >200ms p50->p95 tail degradation and some 503 errors. CS notified key accounts.

Luka Petrov: logs show repeated KV insert spikes like: ```
[2026-06-04T02:01:15Z] shard=27 op=kv_put keys=2800 size_added=65MB prefix="user:prompt:xyz" model=Mistral-Base-gqa
[2026-06-04T02:01:16Z] shard=27 op=kv_put keys=3001 size_added=72MB prefix="user:prompt:abc" model=Qwen-MQA
```
These kv_put bursts align with cont-batch flushes.

Evan Chen: I think the continuous-batching adaptive window overshot when it saw multiple small prompts merge into long sequences due to a recent tokenizer change on Qwen-MQA. We pushed that tokenizer tweak in the last canary at 01:40Z.

Devon Li: Good call. Rolling back tokenizer on the canary nodes now. Command: `deploy rollback qwen-tokenizer canary-2026-06-04-0140`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for qwen-tokenizer on canary-2026-06-04-0140 by Devon Li

Maria Gonzales: Meanwhile customers asking about data loss — no, KV entry evictions are aggressive but we didn't drop request responses. It's performance and errors due to backend timeouts. CS updating customers.

Luka Petrov: I'm going to temporarily throttle cont-batch flush size to cap at 64 items per flush on the affected shards. Patch incoming to runtime config: `kv.contbatch.max_flush_items=64`

Devon Li: Apply patch to eu-west1 shard pool first, then roll global if stable. I'll patch and force a config reload.

Evan Chen: Also flipping on manual prefix eviction for top hot prefixes: `kv.evict prefix=user:prompt:* retain=10MB` to reclaim space while batch window is tuned.

Alice Park: Oncall handover: I'm taking the initial pager until 03:00Z and then Luka will take remainder. Luka confirm?

Luka Petrov: Confirmed. I'll pick up at 03:00Z.

oncall-rotation-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: Alice Park -> Luka Petrov at 03:00Z 2026-06-04

deploy-bot: Config patch applied to eu-west1 shard pool: kv.contbatch.max_flush_items=64 by Devon Li. Rolling to rest of clusters in 5m if stable.

Devon Li: Patch looks good, mem usage trending down on rid-27 from 94% -> 76% in last 90s. p95 latency dropping from 1.8s -> 1.2s.

Maria Gonzales: Updated customers: mitigation in progress, rollback + throttles applied, monitoring. CS message sent to affected tenants, offered elevated support.

Luka Petrov: After I take over I'll run a targeted canary to re-evaluate tokenizer change impact across Mistral-Base and Qwen-MQA, and run a synthetic workload to validate cont-batch sizing heuristics. Plan: canary verify -> gradual model routing to older quant variant if spikes return.

Alice Park: Quick note: avoid global cache clear; prefer targeted evictions and throttle. Global clears will cause cold-start latency regressions for many customers.

Evan Chen: Also creating an eval harness run against our canary prompts that replicate the multi-prompt merge pattern. Will post results here in 15m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations applied (tokenizer rollback canary, contbatch throttle on eu-west1, targeted evictions). Severity: degraded. Next update in 10m or on significant change.

Customer Ops Bot: Notifying external incident channel and sending status update to paid customers with dedicated nodes.

Luka Petrov: taking over incident, monitoring metrics + logs. If tail latency doesn't stabilize I'll cut traffic to Qwen-MQA model variant and fallback to Qwen-Base for affected tenants.

Alice Park: Thanks team — handing off. Leaving runbook notes in the incident ticket.

Luka Petrov: Acknowledged. Will continue until resolved or escalated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: automated checks show mem pressure normalized and p95 within SLA thresholds at 03:40Z. Postmortem requested.
